missions.name: Lord Gabriel
missions.description: "The Rise of Darkness" has roused many nameless heroes, still loyal to the true Emperor Duncan, to stand united against the forces of chaos. Lord Gabriel is one of them. He is from Beryl Mountain and is related to the holy emperor's family. We've been watching him carefully, and think he is destined for greatness. You are to help him rout General Wallace, one of the Dark Forces' top leaders. You will participate in a pincer movement. Lord Gabriel will attack from behind and you will attack from the front. The mission objective is to eliminate General Wallace. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Lord Frederick
missions.description: "The Rise of Darkness" has roused many nameless heroes, still loyal to the true Emperor Duncan, to stand united against the forces of chaos. Lord Frederick is one of them. He is from Cerise Plains and is currently just an apprentice knight.. We've been watching him carefully, and think he is destined for greatness. You are to help him rout General Philip, one of the Dark Forces' top leaders. You will participate in a pincer movement. Lord Frederick will attack from behind and you will attack from the front. The mission objective is to eliminate General Philip. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Lord Vincent
missions.description: "The Rise of Darkness" has roused many nameless heroes, still loyal to the true Emperor Duncan, to stand united against the forces of chaos. Lord Wesley is one of them. He is the lord of Auric River and known as a fierce warrior.. We've been watching him carefully, and think he is destined for greatness. You are to help him rout General Langley, one of the Dark Forces' top leaders. You will participate in a pincer movement. Lord Wesley will attack from behind and you will attack from the front. The mission objective is to eliminate General Langley. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Lord Edison
missions.description: The Dark Forces have dispatched their armies all over the continent. General Augustine, one of the three heads of the Dark Forces and the younger brother of Lord Brendan, has entered the area and is vulnerable to attack. You will need to launch a full frontal assault on General Augustine. This is a tough mission, but if you are successful you will be richly rewarded. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Lord Gabriel
missions.description: Thanks in part to your brilliant assault, General Wallace's brigade is now in tatters. Lord Gabriel has shifted his attention to engaging General Drake's army. The mission objective is to eliminate General Drake. What say you?

missions.name: Lord Frederick
missions.description: Thanks in part to your brilliant assault, General Philip's brigade is now in tatters. Lord Frederick has shifted his attention to engaging General Dunstan's army. The mission objective is to eliminate General Dunstan. What say you?

missions.name: Lord Vincent
missions.description: Thanks in part to your brilliant assault, General Peter's brigade is now in tatters. Lord Wesley has shifted his attention to engaging General Lord Brendan's army. The mission objective is to eliminate General Lord Brendan. What say you?

missions.name: Lord Edgar
missions.description: We are on the verge of a breakthrough! That evil dog, Lord Brendan, is in danger. His situation on the battlefield is desperate, and he has sent an urgent request for reinforcements. Your task is to engage Lord Brendan and vanquish the ferocious warriors that serve him before help arrives. Do you accept this critical mission?

missions.name: Lord Herbert
missions.description: You've done well! Lord Brendan's armies have been annihilated, leading to a brief respite from this unending violence. However, the problem runs deeper than we thought: this time it is Lord Geoffrey, Liege of Amethyst Desert, who is behind the chaos. After Lord Brendan went down in defeat, Lord Geoffrey's stature within Empyrean Castle grew, along with his armies and ambition.Lord Geoffrey recently dethroned Emperor Duncan the Grey, replacing him with his younger sister, the newly crowned Empress Beatrice. Needless to say, Lord Geoffrey is now the real power behind the throne. Heroes from around the kingdom have united to declare Lord Geoffrey's actions unlawful and unsanctioned. Allied forces are marching to Empyrean Castle as we speak! Lord Gabriel has set out with Lord Bartholomew to support the Allies. Your job is to engage Lord Geoffrey's new vassal, General Catherine, the first female general in the Empire's long history. Can you do it?

missions.name: Lord Eugene
missions.description: You've done well! Lord Brendan's armies have been annihilated, leading to a brief respite from this unending violence. However, the problem runs deeper than we thought: this time it is Lord Geoffrey, Liege of Amethyst Desert, who is behind the chaos. After Lord Brendan went down in defeat, Lord Geoffrey's stature within Empyrean Castle grew, along with his armies and ambition.Lord Geoffrey recently dethroned Emperor Duncan the Grey, replacing him with his younger sister, the newly crowned Empress Beatrice. Needless to say, Lord Geoffrey is now the real power behind the throne. Heroes from around the kingdom have united to declare Lord Geoffrey's actions unlawful and unsanctioned. Allied forces are marching to Empyrean Castle as we speak! Lord Eugene of Crimson Ocean is moving to support the Allies. Your job is to engage Lord Geoffrey's new vassal, General Catherine, the first female general in the Empire's long history. Can you do it?

missions.name: Lord Frederick
missions.description: You've done well! Lord Brendan's armies have been annihilated, leading to a brief respite from this unending violence. However, the problem runs deeper than we thought: this time it is Lord Geoffrey, Liege of Amethyst Desert, who is behind the chaos. Needless to say, Lord Geoffrey is now the real power behind the throne. Heroes from around the kingdom have united to declare Lord Geoffrey's actions unlawful and unsanctioned. Allied forces are marching to Empyrean Castle as we speak! Lord Frederick has organized a band of heroes and is heading to support the Allies. Your job is to engage Lord Geoffrey's new vassal, General Catherine, the first female general in the Empire's long history. Can you do it?

missions.name: Lord Vincent
missions.description: You've done well! Lord Brendan's armies have been annihilated, leading to a brief respite from this unending violence. However, the problem runs deeper than we thought: this time it is Lord Geoffrey, Liege of Amethyst Desert, who is behind the chaos. After Lord Brendan went down in defeat, Lord Geoffrey's stature within Empyrean Castle grew, along with his armies and ambition.Lord Geoffrey recently dethroned Emperor Duncan the Grey, replacing him with his younger sister, the newly crowned Empress Beatrice. Needless to say, Lord Geoffrey is now the real power behind the throne. Heroes from around the kingdom have united to declare Lord Geoffrey's actions unlawful and unsanctioned. Allied forces are marching to Empyrean Castle as we speak! Lord Wesley of Auric River is moving to support the Allies. Your job is to engage Lord Geoffrey's new vassal, General Catherine, the first female general in the Empire's long history. Can you do it?

missions.name: Lord Benjamin
missions.description: After Lord Brendan's Dark forces were annihilated, Lord Geoffrey's stature as a leader in Empyrean Castle grew. Lord Geoffrey may be dimwitted and greedy, but he also is an excellent judge of character. He is accompanied by General Conrad--known to his enemies as the Butcher--and is generally regarded as the strongest man in the Empire.Lord Geoffrey has dethroned Duncan the Grey and declared Duncan's younger sister, Beatrice, the new Empress. These actions have turned the people's sentiment against Lord Geoffrey, and rebels from around the kingdom have banned together and declared Lord Geoffrey's actions unlawful and unsanctioned. These rebels have organized their forces against Lord Geoffrey and marched to Empyrean Castle. Lord Wesley is leading this rabble. They are now gathered in front of Fort Hell Gate to unleash their attack. General Catherine, the first female general in the Empire's illustrious history, has taken up the sword against the rebels and is requesting reinforcements from us. Your mission objective is to engage Lord Wesley and quell the rebel attack. Will you fight him?

missions.name: Lord Herbert
missions.description: General Catherine's forces have been vanquished, and we offer you our thanks for your prominent role in the battle. It is a shame that such a talented general as Catherine is now a footnote in the Empire's history, simply because she served the wrong lord. However, you now have a bigger obstacle ahead of you: the infamous General Conrad, known as the Butcher. Are you brave enough to challenge him?

missions.name: Lord Benjamin
missions.description: Bad news: the rebel forces who retreated in cowardice have returned! Your valiant effort was for naught. General Conrad is now on the move to take his revenge against the rebels and has requested your support. Your mission objective is to eliminate Lord Wesley. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Lord Vincent
missions.description: The allies have defeated Lord Geoffrey's army, but Lord Geoffrey somehow escaped. In the process, he has taken Empress Beatrice hostage. Empyrean Castle has been ransacked and the place now stands deserted. Out of respect for the safety of Empress Beatrice, the allied forces have decided not to chase Lord Geoffrey's forces and have instead dispersed into smaller groups. In another turn of events, Lord Wesley discovered the sought after Royal Seal, and on his way home was promptly attacked by Lord Caden of Regal Canyon. Lord Wesley was fortunate enough to escape with his life, and is now leading a punitive mission back to Regal Canyon to settle the score. Your mission objective is to support Lord Wesley in his counter-attack. Yes or no?

missions.name: Lord Anthony
missions.description: Lord Wesley has discovered the coveted Royal Seal. Lord Caden of Regal Canyon ambushed Lord Wesley in hopes of recovering the Royal Seal himself, but good fortune shone upon Lord Wesley and he escaped. Now, Lord Wesley is heading back to Regal Canyon for a counter-attack and Lord Caden is in distress. Lord Caden knows he cannot face an enraged Lord Wesley by himself and has pleaded for support. Your mission objective is to intercept Lord Wesley and stop him. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Lord Herbert
missions.description: Lord Bartholomew is foolish indeed! It is a good thing Lord Gabriel disassociated with Lord Bartholomew prior to the upcoming battle. Here is the story: Lord Bartholomew returned to his land, White Highland, dissatisfied with his holdings, even though he had made off with a modest amount of gold stolen from Empyrean Castle. He decided to expand his land by annexing Ecru Terra, a plot of land adjacent to his property.The clever Lord Eugene became aware of Lord Bartholomew's intentions and cooked up a plan to swindle him. Lord Eugene contacted Lord Bartholomew and suggested they jointly attack Ecru Terra and split the land. After Lord Bartholomew agreed, Lord Eugene dispatched a messenger to Lord Berenger of Ecru Terra to warn him of Lord Bartholomew's impending attack on his land. Out of fear, Lord Berenger asked Lord Eugene for help, which allowed Lord Eugene to move into Ecru Terra and bloodlessly conquer the land himself. Lord Bartholomew soon learned he had been cheated, and sent his younger brother, General Sonton, to deliver a message to Lord Eugene, demanding his share of the Ecru Terra. In response, Lord Eugene has executed General Sonton, and now an enraged Lord Bartholomew is charging towards Lord Eugene's army, vowing to unleash carnage. Lord Bartholomew has requested your support. Will you help him revenge himself upon Lord Eugene?

missions.name: Lord Eugene
missions.description: Lord Eugene sent Lord Bartholomew a letter, suggesting they attack Ecru Terra and split the land evenly. Once Lord Bartholomew agreed to the plan, Lord Eugene dispatched a messenger to Lord Berenger of Ecru Terra warning him of Lord Bartholomew's preparation to seize his land. Fearing for his safety, Lord Berenger asked Lord Eugene for help. Lord Eugene agreed and promptly moved into Ecru Terra, conquering it as he went.Lord Bartholomew realized that he had been swindled and sent General Sonton, his younger brother, to demand his share of Ecru Terra. Instead, Lord Eugene cold-bloodedly executed General Sonton. An enraged Lord Bartholomew is now charging towards Lord Eugene's forces to avenge his brother's death. Lord Eugene is requesting your support. Your mission objective is to quell Lord Bartholomew's assault. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Lord Herbert
missions.description: We are reaching the turning point of this battle. Lord Bartholomew and Lord Eugene are now both battling for their very lives: no quarter will be asked, and none given. Lord Bartholomew is requesting your support. Your mission objective is to turn the tide of the battle and lead Lord Bartholomew to victory. Will you do it?

missions.name: Lord Eugene
missions.description: We are reaching the turning point of this battle. Lord Bartholomew and Lord Eugene are now both battling for their very lives: no quarter will be asked, and none given. Lord Eugene is requesting your support. Your mission objective is to turn the tide of the battle and lead  to victory. Will you do it?

missions.name: Lord Frederick
missions.description: After Lord Caleb fled from Lord Frederick, Lord Frederick took to harassing Lord Caleb's sister-in-law. We have just caught wind of rumors that Lord Caleb is planning to assassinate Lord Frederick to protect his family's honor. Lord Frederick is requesting your support. Your mission objective is to protect Lord Frederick from Lord Caleb��s assault. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Lord Charles
missions.description: After Lord Caleb fled from Lord Frederick, Lord Frederick took to harassing Lord Caleb's sister-in-law. We have just caught wind of rumors that Lord Caleb is planning to assassinate Lord Frederick to protect his family's honor. Lord Caleb has appealed to us for help. Your mission objective is to protect Lord Frederick from Lord Caleb��s assault. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Lord Jacob
missions.description: After Lord Wesley's heroic death in battle, Lord Jaron made his way to Lord Barclay to ask for help. Lord Wesley's older supporters are now banding together along with fresh troops to press the assault. Lord Jaron will be defending his uncle against Lord Wesley's supporters in battle and has requested support. Your mission objective is to intercept Lord Wesley's supporters. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Lord Donald
missions.description: After Lord Wesley's heroic death in battle, Lord Jaron made his way to Lord Barclay to ask for help. Lord Wesley's older supporters are now banding together along with fresh troops to press the assault. Lord Jaron will be defending his uncle against Lord Wesley's supporters in battle and has requested support. Your mission objective is to intercept Lord Wesley's supporters. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Lord Gabriel
missions.description: Lord Geoffrey has been assassinated by Lord Conrad, and now Lord Frederick is guarding Empress Beatrice. In light of this new development, Lord Gabriel and Lord Conrad have joined forces. Lord Frederick is wary of their alliance and has thus put in motion a plan to entrap them both. Lord Barclay is now charging toward Lord Gabriel. Your mission objective is to rendezvous with Lord Barclay and assault Lord Gabriel. Can you help?

missions.name: Lord Ferdinand
missions.description: Lord Geoffrey has been assassinated by Lord Conrad, and now Lord Frederick is guarding Empress Beatrice. In light of this new development, Lord Gabriel and Lord Conrad have joined forces. Lord Frederick is wary of their alliance and has thus put in motion a plan to entrap them both. He has bribed Lord Barclay to attack Lord Gabriel. Your mission objective is to rendezvous with  and assault . Can you help?

missions.name: Lord Conrad
missions.description: Lord Frederick is preparing to capture Lord Conrad. Lord Conrad has heard about these developments and has appealed for your support. The Empire's strongest man almost always refuses aid, but he needs assistance now. Will you fight for him?

missions.name: Lord Gabriel
missions.description: Lord Frederick is preparing to capture Lord Conrad. Lord Gabriel has requested your support during the operation. Will you fight for him?

missions.name: Lord Frederick
missions.description: Lord Frederick is preparing to capture Lord Conrad. Knowing that he is in for a fight, Lord Frederick is requesting additional support. Will you fight for him?

missions.name: Lord Conrad
missions.description: Lord Barclay has invoked the power of the Royal Seal that he seized from Lord Jaron, and has declared himself the new Emperor. Those unwilling to bend the knee to Lord Barclay are forming up all across the kingdom are marching an army to Lord Barclay's land. Lord Conrad is planning to meet up with them and has requested your support. Your mission is to join the assault on the would-be Emperor. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Lord Gabriel
missions.description: Lord Barclay has invoked the power of the Royal Seal that he seized from Lord Jaron, and has declared himself the new Emperor. Those unwilling to bend the knee to Lord Barclay are forming up all across the kingdom are marching an army to Lord Barclay's land.  Lord Gabriel is also on the way and has requested your support. Your mission is to join the assault on the would-be Emperor. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Lord Frederick
missions.description: Lord Barclay has invoked the power of the Royal Seal that he seized from Lord Jaron, and has declared himself the new Emperor. Those unwilling to bend the knee to Lord Barclay are forming up all across the kingdom are marching an army to Lord Barclay's land.  Lord Frederick is also on the way and has requested your support. Your mission is to join the assault on the would-be Emperor. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Lord Jacob
missions.description: Lord Barclay has invoked the power of the Royal Seal that he seized from Lord Jaron, and has declared himself the new Emperor. Those unwilling to bend the knee to Lord Barclay are forming up all across the kingdom are marching an army to Lord Barclay's land.  Lord Jaron is also on the way and has requested your support. Your mission is to join the assault on the would-be Emperor. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Lord Ferdinand
missions.description: Lord Barclay has invoked the power of the Royal Seal that he seized from Lord Jaron, and has declared himself the new Emperor. Those unwilling to bend the knee to Lord Barclay are forming up all across the kingdom are marching an army to Lord Barclay's land.  Lord Barclay is in trouble and is desperately pleading for help. Your mission is to join the assault on the would-be Emperor. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Lord Frederick
missions.description: Lord Frederick's tactician put into action a plan to assassinate Lord Gabriel covertly. General Augustine was able to foil the assassination attempt, and killed Lord Frederick's murderous underling in response. A furious Lord Frederick launched an all-out campaign to capture or kill Lord Gabriel and General Callahan, but they've somehow managed to escape the onslaught. Now General Augustine has been left trying to defend Cerise Castle all by himself. Your objective is to capture General Augustine. Will you go to Cerise Castle?

missions.name: Lord Gabriel
missions.description: Lord Frederick's tactician put into action a plan to assassinate Lord Gabriel covertly. General Augustine was able to foil the assassination attempt, and killed Lord Frederick's murderous underling in response. A furious Lord Frederick launched an all-out campaign to capture or kill Lord Gabriel and General Callahan, but they've somehow managed to escape the onslaught. Now General Augustine has been left trying to defend Cerise Castle all by himself. Your objective is to Help General Augustine defend Cerise Castle. Will you go to Cerise Castle?

missions.name: Lord Eugene
missions.description: We are finally reaching the end of this saga. Lord Eugene and Lord Frederick continue to battle with every ounce of strength they still possess. Lord Eugene is marching onward toward White Horse Field, but Lord Frederick has been stopped cold by Lord Eugene's two veteran Generals, Cromwell and Beresford. Your mission objective is to help Lord Eugene vanquish Lord Frederick's forces. Will you perform this duty?

missions.name: Lord Frederick
missions.description: We are finally reaching the end of this saga. Lord Eugene and Lord Frederick continue to battle with every ounce of strength they still possess. Lord Eugene is marching onward toward White Horse Field, but Lord Frederick has been stopped cold by Lord Eugene's two veteran Generals, Cromwell and Beresford. Your mission objective is to help Lord Frederick vanquish Lord Eugene's forces. Will you perform this duty?

missions.name: Lord Eugene
missions.description: Lord Eugene launched a pre-emptive attack on Lord Frederick, hoping to catch him off guard. 700,000 soldiers loyal to Lord Eugene have gathered and are heading towards Lord Frederick's manor. It seems clear that the victor of this battle will win control of the entire continent. Lord Eugene is requesting your support. Your mission objective is to aid in Lord Eugene's assault on Lord Frederick. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Lord Frederick
missions.description: Lord Eugene launched a pre-emptive attack on Lord Frederick, hoping to catch him off guard. 700,000 soldiers loyal to Lord Eugene have gathered and are heading towards Lord Frederick's manor. It seems clear that the victor of this battle will win control of the entire continent. Lord Frederick is requesting your support. Your mission objective is to aid in Lord Eugene's assault on Lord Frederick. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Lord Gabriel
missions.description: While languishing in Lord Frederick's captivity, General Augustine secretly received a letter from Lord Gabriel indicating his position. General Augustine offered to switch sides and pledge allegiance to Lord Frederick, but Lord Frederick sneeringly refused to release him.To escape Lord Frederick's land, General Augustine needs a permit that allows him to pass through the five gates separating him from freedom. There's no time for that, however, as Lord Gabriel is pleading for immediate support. Your mission objective is to fight your way through these five gates to penetrate Lord Frederick's forces and meet up with Lord Gabriel. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Lord Gabriel
missions.description: After losing the battle at Beryl Fields, Lord Gabriel left Lord Eugene's land and settled in Bequest Castle. However, Lord Frederick's hatred burns as brightly as ever, and he is dispatching all his troops to run him down. Lord Gabriel is asking you to rescue him. What will you do?

missions.name: Lord Frederick
missions.description: After losing the battle at Beryl Fields, Lord Gabriel left Lord Eugene's land and settled in Bequest Castle. However, Lord Frederick's hatred burns as brightly as ever, and he is dispatching all his troops to run him down. Lord Frederick needs your assistance to capture Lord Gabriel. What will you do?

missions.name: Lord Eugene
missions.description: Lord Eugene has died from an infected wound. Before he passed, he anointed his youngest son, Edmar, as his successor, over the objections of his two elder sons, Faramond and Luke. Lord Frederick senses an opportunity to strike: he wishes to completely destroy Lord Eugene's lineage. Lord Edmar needs your help if he is to stay alive. Will you participate?

missions.name: Lord Frederick
missions.description: Lord Eugene has died from an infected wound. Before he passed, he anointed his youngest son, Edmar, as his successor, over the objections of his two elder sons, Faramond and Luke. Lord Frederick senses an opportunity to strike: he wishes to completely destroy Lord Eugene's lineage. Lord Frederick would like you to help him eliminate the young Lord Edmar. Will you participate?

missions.name: Lord Eugene
missions.description: Faramond was killed in the assault, but the target of the operation, Lord Edmar, managed a daring escape. He has taken up refuge with his remaining brother, Luke. Lord Frederick wants to finish Lord Eugene's sons off once and for all. Lord Edmar is making his last stand, and he won't live long without your help. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Lord Frederick
missions.description: Faramond was killed in the assault, but the target of the operation, Lord Edmar, managed a daring escape. He has taken up refuge with his remaining brother, Luke. Lord Frederick wants to finish Lord Eugene's sons off once and for all.  He wishes to retain your services for this strike. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Lord Gabriel
missions.description: Lord Gabriel is now under Lord Caden's protection. He has hired a talented young commander and is pulling his troops together. Lord Frederick wants them both dead before their forces grow too powerful. Lord Gabriel knows that Lord Frederick's army is on its way, and has requested that you intercept Lord Frederick. Do you want to get involved?

missions.name: Lord Frederick
missions.description: Lord Gabriel is now under Lord Caden's protection. He has hired a talented young commander and is pulling his troops together. Lord Frederick wants them both dead before their forces grow too powerful. Lord Frederick will need your help to lay Lord Gabriel low. Do you want to get involved?

missions.name: Lord Gabriel
missions.description: Lord Frederick has put his bitter rival Lord Gabriel in grave peril, but Lord Gabriel will never surrender, as long as blood courses through his veins. Lord Gabriel seeks your sword for the coming battle. Do you agree to fight?

missions.name: Lord Frederick
missions.description: Lord Frederick has put his bitter rival Lord Gabriel in grave peril, but Lord Gabriel will never surrender, as long as blood courses through his veins. Lord Frederick needs you to hunt down Lord Gabriel and finish him. Do you agree to fight?

missions.name: Lord Leonard
missions.description: Lord Marquise, Lord Jaron's successor, has not been idle. He has recruited many wise and experienced generals to help him take vengeance on Lord Caden, on behalf of his father. Lord Marquise wishes you to join his army for this battle. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Lord Anthony
missions.description: Lord Marquise, Lord Jaron's successor, has not been idle. He has recruited many wise and experienced generals to help him take vengeance on Lord Caden, on behalf of his father. Lord Caden is requesting your help to protect his land. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Lord Gabriel
missions.description: Lord Frederick has lost his last two battles against Lord Gabriel, but these stinging defeats have only caused him to redouble his efforts against his sworn enemy. Lord Frederick's forces are strong, but Lord Gabriel has just discovered a brilliant young commander, General Maxwell, who is poised to turn the tables on Lord Frederick. Lord Gabriel wishes you to join General Maxwell in the field. Will you take on this challenge?

missions.name: Lord Frederick
missions.description: Lord Frederick has lost his last two battles against Lord Gabriel, but these stinging defeats have only caused him to redouble his efforts against his sworn enemy. Lord Frederick's forces are strong, but Lord Gabriel has just discovered a brilliant young commander, General Maxwell, who is poised to turn the tables on Lord Frederick. Accordingly, Lord Frederick is looking for his own secret weapon: you.. Will you take on this challenge?

missions.name: Lord Gabriel
missions.description: Lord Frederick is hot in pursuit of Lord Gabriel, who is being slowed by the sheer number of troops he is leading. Lord Gabriel's ally, General Callahan, is doing his best to fend off Lord Frederick's forces, but it looks as though his flanks will soon collapse. Lord Gabriel needs you to halt Lord Frederick's advance. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Lord Frederick
missions.description: Lord Frederick is hot in pursuit of Lord Gabriel, who is being slowed by the sheer number of troops he is leading. Lord Gabriel's ally, General Callahan, is doing his best to fend off Lord Frederick's forces, but it looks as though his flanks will soon collapse. Lord Frederick is looking to you to defeat General Callahan and apprehend Lord Gabriel. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Lord Gabriel
missions.description: Lord Gabriel is still on the run from Lord Frederick, who has shown no signs of giving up his single-minded pursuit. Following General Maxwell's advice, Lord Gabriel has evacuated a hundred thousand of his subjects from his land, and led them in search of a safer haven.Compounding his worries, Lord Gabriel's family has somehow separated from the crowd of refugees. They are believed to be hiding from Lord Frederick's forces somewhere nearby. Lord Gabriel desperately wants his family back! You will have to leave the relative safety of Lord Gabriel's troops to find his missing family. Are you willing to accept the risk?

missions.name: Lord Gabriel
missions.description: The joined forces of Lords Gabriel and Marquise are preparing to face off against Lord Frederick's army once more. Lord Frederick's failure to run Lord Gabriel to ground in the previous battle was a personal embarrassment, and he is determined not to fail again. General Maxwell's sage counsel has served Lord Gabriel in good stead, and he is currently cooking up something new for the next fight. I am not sure what General Maxwell is working on, but it seems to be vital to his plans for the upcoming battle. General Maxwell must be protected while he prepares his secret weapon! Lord Gabriel has requested your support. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Lord Frederick
missions.description: The joined forces of Lords Gabriel and Marquise are preparing to face off against Lord Frederick's army once more. Lord Frederick's failure to run Lord Gabriel to ground in the previous battle was a personal embarrassment, and he is determined not to fail again. General Maxwell's sage counsel has served Lord Gabriel in good stead, and he is currently cooking up something new for the next fight. I am not sure what General Maxwell is working on, but it seems to be vital to his plans for the upcoming battle. General Maxwell must be defeated before he completes his preparations! Lord Frederick has requested your support. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Lord Leonard
missions.description: Lord Marquise and Lord Frederick are facing each other on the battlefield. The importance of this fight to the outcome of the war cannot be understated; songs will be sung of the victor for generations.. Privy to the choices of fate as we are, we know who must be the victor. Lord Marquise has requested your support to defeat Lord Frederick. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Lord Frederick
missions.description: Lord Marquise and Lord Frederick are facing each other on the battlefield. The importance of this fight to the outcome of the war cannot be understated; songs will be sung of the victor for generations.. Privy to the choices of fate as we are, we know who must be the victor.  Lord Frederick has requested your support to defeat Lord Marquise Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Lord Leonard
missions.description: "He changed the direction of a storm and used it to attack the enemy with fire?! General Maxwell must be a wizard!" Like everyone else, Lord Marquise is now afraid of General Maxwell's wondrous abilities?even though these same talents once helped to save his own life. Lord Marquise wants to ensure General Maxwell's miracles are not eventually turned against him. Your mission objective is to capture General Maxwell, who is making his way back to Lord Gabriel's front line. What is your choice?

missions.name: Lord Gabriel
missions.description: "He changed the direction of a storm and used it to attack the enemy with fire?! General Maxwell must be a wizard!" Like everyone else, Lord Marquise is now afraid of General Maxwell's wondrous abilities?even though these same talents once helped to save his own life. Lord Marquise wants to ensure General Maxwell's miracles are not eventually turned against him. Your mission objective is to guard General Maxwell and ensure his safe passage to Lord Gabriel's front line. What is your choice?

missions.name: Lord Gabriel
missions.description: Lord Frederick's armies have finally failed, and the defeated noble is retreating from the battlefield in disgrace. Lord Gabriel wants to prevent Lord Frederick from escaping, and requires your assistance. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Lord Frederick
missions.description: Lord Frederick's armies have finally failed, and the defeated noble is retreating from the battlefield in disgrace. Lord Frederick will need your assistance to make good his escape. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Lord Leonard
missions.description: Even though Lord Frederick met a shameful defeat and retreated, Lord Marquise chose to press his advantage all the way to the borders of Lord Frederick's manor. Of course, the fiery Lord Frederick has vowed never to capitulate or retreat! Even though he had the upper hand, Lord Marquise was nearly captured by Lord Frederick, who surely would have put him to death. Now, a chastened Lord Marquise is using a decoy to lure Lord Frederick to Soul Valley. Lord Marquise has requested your support. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Lord Frederick
missions.description: Even though Lord Frederick met a shameful defeat and retreated, Lord Marquise chose to press his advantage all the way to the borders of Lord Frederick's manor. Of course, the fiery Lord Frederick has vowed never to capitulate or retreat! Even though he had the upper hand, Lord Marquise was nearly captured by Lord Frederick, who surely would have put him to death. Now, a chastened Lord Marquise is using a decoy to lure Lord Frederick to Soul Valley. Lord Frederick has requested your support. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Lord Aaron
missions.description: Lord Drake, who lost his father at the hands of Lord Frederick, is seeking revenge. Lord Drake is known throughout the realm as Golden Drake because of his courage and valor, and he has allied himself with Lord Jay in an effort to destroy the reeling Lord Frederick. Now, the military genius General Maxwell has lured Lord Frederick into a battle at Sterling Mountain. Lord Drake has requested your support. Will you help him?

missions.name: Lord Frederick
missions.description: Lord Drake, who lost his father at the hands of Lord Frederick, is seeking revenge. Lord Drake is known throughout the realm as Golden Drake because of his courage and valor, and he has allied himself with Lord Jay in an effort to destroy the reeling Lord Frederick.
